name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 11 times in 5 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.40 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
